newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says Australia jobs growth on target.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says Australia jobs growth on target.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Thursday that jobs growth was track to meet budget forecasts.

"What we talked about was over the course of the year we'd get two percent growth in employment - we're on track in relation to that," Costello said in an interview on Australian Broadcasting Corp radio.
Costello also said he expected unemployment to fall in line with 1996/97 budget forecasts to 8.25 percent by June next year.
Asked if the government was on track for the 8.25 percent target, Costello said: "By the end of the year it would be coming off and we're on track in relation to that."
Australia's unemployment rate was 8.7 percent in September.
October figures are due out later on Thursday.
The government, in its budget for the year to June 30, 1997, projected employment to grow 2.0 percent.
